summary: Verified the i18n fix for the Road (Career Path) task sheet, milestone sheet, canvas labels and the daily-plan item resource sheet across EN, DE and PL (regression) using the live Expo web preview and account ania_t1@test.pl (has an existing built roadmap). All previously hardcoded Polish strings in TaskSheet.tsx and RoadMap.tsx now correctly follow the selected UI language.
critical_code_review_comments: TaskSheet.tsx and RoadMap.tsx are now correctly wired via useAuth().t.road.* for all UI chrome strings; code review confirms no remaining hardcoded Polish literals in these components.

Note (not a bug, by design): AI-generated roadmap/task content (milestone titles, descriptions, requirements, resource titles/descriptions, step text) is generated once in the language active at creation time and cached — it does NOT retranslate when the user later switches UI language. This matches the Profile screen's own disclaimer ('Already generated paths/plans don't change') and was reproduced in all 3 languages tested (content stayed in the original generation language while all i18n chrome correctly switched).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all checked labels rendered correctly in EN/DE/PL)

rca_of_issue: Original bug (now fixed and verified): TaskSheet.tsx and RoadMap.tsx had ~20 hardcoded Polish literals with no i18n lookup. Fix added a `road` namespace of keys to pl/en/de/nl.ts and replaced every hardcoded string with t.road.* lookups. Verified fix is complete and correct for all UI chrome strings; confirmed this is the full scope of the originally reported bug.
